hypothesis: Withheld whole fault branches are enriched near termini of visible branches, after removing cut-induced endpoints within the holdout collar.
mechanism: One distance-to-filtered-terminal feature appended to the repository's no_side anatomy baseline.
named_non_fault_mimic: Road and dry-wash termini, map-sheet breaks, and digitization endpoints.

predicted_direction_and_range_not_score.contrast: candidate HOLDOUT-DTI minus matched no_side HOLDOUT-DTI
predicted_direction_and_range_not_score.qualification: Pre-run expectation only; zero or negative is plausible. This is not a measured score and is not a leaderboard projection.

matched_budget.rule: realized counts must match per holdout cell; otherwise contrast is non-comparable and cannot promote

holdout.uncertainty: paired physical 20 km spatial-block bootstrap 95% CI

canary.rule: AUC above threshold is leakage until proven otherwise; no promotion if any feature is flagged.

promotion_rule: Positive paired 95% CI lower bound versus no_side, matched realized dot counts, and a clean feature canary; this only enables separate registry/format gates and does not select a weekly slot.
